items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Used to be right down here off of the Frenchman and, is that the one you're talking about? One off of Frenchman's Creek?

ctx.x: Yeah, I just heard of it once.

Used to be right down here off of the Frenchman and, is that the one you're talking about? One off of Frenchman's Creek? Yeah. Frenchman and Elysian Field? Somewhere around. That's why it was called Elysian. Yeah. And Elysian Field runs there. Of course, you had these theaters up here in town off Iberville Street, the old palace. Mm-hmm. And you had the Orpheum. Is that still going? The Orpheum?
Yeah. It's still going. But the palace is gone. It's not quite the same thing. But the palace is gone. The palace is gone.
